Priya D: Quick async standup — model onboarding + evals
Priya D: Yesterday: finished promptset v3.2 sweep for rerankers, found 12 regressions on 'clarity' submetric. Posted results in the eval dashboard.
Mike L: Saw the heatmap, looks like truncation on long contexts. I think KV-cache alignment is off for the tinyq build.
Anna K: Reproducible locally with seed=42: `python -m evals.runner --promptset prompts/rerank_v3.json --model llm-lite:tinyq --seed 42` — failing in 2/50.
Sara P: Blocker: CI flaky on `tests/evals/test_prompt_sets.py::test_rerank_smoke` — hanging on GPU node 3. Filed #2012.
Priya D: Today: will 1) bisect v3.2 prompts to isolate failing set; 2) open PR with tinyq kv-cache test; 3) coordinate canary if patch looks good.
Kevin R: Ping @Anna K on SHAP weighting change — if you patch prompt tokenization that could explain metric drift.
Anna K: Noted, will check tokenization before bisect. Also adding a quick smoke harness: ```bash
# run quick smoke
pytest tests/evals/test_prompt_sets.py -k smoke -q
```
Mike L: If it's kv-cache, try running with `--disable-prefetch` in runtime, that changed recent behavior.
Sara P: CI owner update: I restarted the failing runner, kept logs at `gs://redwood-evals/logs/2026-03-10/`.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment for `tinyq-v1.7` completed to shard-3 :white_check_mark: (172s)
Priya D: FYI rolling canary manually paused because of rerank regressions — won't promote until regressions <= 2.
Kevin R: I can take the bisect after lunch, tag me in the PR with `@kevin`.
Anna K: Added unit to catch tokenization mismatch to my branch PR #2105, ready for review.
Mike L: Quick ask — can someone add the failing prompt examples to the eval ticket? saves time.
Priya D: Done. Added minimal repros + golden outputs to #2012. Also left a note on the Console under model/llm-lite:tinyq.
Sara P: Today: will keep CI watch, try to repro on prod mirror, and coordinate with infra if runner crashes again.
Priya D: Thanks team. If no blocker after bisect, I'll open canary patch PR and request review. :thumbsup:
Kevin R: :thumbsup:
Anna K: :shipit:
Mike L: LGTM
